title: Lightning Vault
subtitle: Amperehelion Vault, entrance to the Major Sparking Stone

notes.title: Don't fall into the centre shaft
notes.body: Two drops in the centre shaft land on a Surface Portal (marked in red) and you're out. The route uses the three safe drops instead.

notes.title: Use acid, not lightning
notes.body: Everything here is immune to lightning. Amethyst Gromnies take full acid damage and the elementals take 65%.

notes.title: What the stone is for
notes.body: Give the Major Sparking Stone to Zahir in Stonehold (68.7N 21.5W) for a Writ of Refuge. The stone respawns 25 seconds after it's taken.
